/ai-os: How EmbeddedOS runs AI workloads on constrained hardware, from 64 KB microcontrollers to NPU-equipped boards, with on-device inference.
/architecture: Interactive diagrams of the EmbeddedOS stack — boot chain, kernel, IPC, data and applications — each labelled with its maturity.
/article-eboot-secure-boot-deepdive: A walkthrough of eBoot's chain of trust: root-of-trust keys, immutable stage 0, signed manifests and anti-rollback counters.
/article-edb-encryption-at-rest: How eDB added page-level AES-XTS encryption with hardware-key offload, and fitting it into 6 KB of code on the smallest target.
/article-eni-1024-channel-pipeline: A research plan for measuring configurable neural acquisition, filtering and decoding pipelines without treating targets as results.
/article-eos-platform-launch: eos-platform 1.0 brings stable APIs, a unified package manifest and reproducible builds across every EoS profile.
/article-eos-roadmap-2026: Three RTOS research targets for 2026: a tickless scheduler, RT-IPC primitives across security domains, and formal verification.
/article-foundation-membership-2026: The 2026 membership cycle opens with three new working groups and a refreshed governance model for Foundation members.
/careers: Open roles and internships at the EmbeddedOS Foundation for embedded engineers, AI researchers and open-source contributors.
/changelog: Release notes for the EmbeddedOS platform — what changed in each version across the kernel, bootloader and developer tooling.
/community: How the EmbeddedOS community works: contributing code, docs and hardware designs, plus where discussion and support happen.
/contact: Reach the Foundation by topic. Security reports are answered within 48 hours; other enquiries within a few business days.
/demo: Run EoS firmware in your browser. Toggle GPIO pins, watch UART output and test programs against simulated STM32, ESP32 and Pico boards.
/eai-edge: An in-development concept for a manifest-pinned eNI to eIPC to eAI workflow. Hardware support and setup steps require validation.
/eboot: A multi-stage verified bootloader for EmbeddedOS devices, with a hardware root of trust and A/B update slots with rollback.
/ebrowser: An embedded browser engine written in C with LVGL rendering and mbedTLS, with a configurable feature set for constrained devices.
/ebuild: The EmbeddedOS build tool. Describe a project in one build.yaml and ebuild resolves the toolchain graph and drives the backend.
/ecad-hardware: 15 hardware design categories from health wearables to aerospace. A mix of design documents, KiCad sources, BOMs and datasheets; coverage varies.
/eflow: A visual block programming environment for EmbeddedOS. Connect GPIO, timer, AI and protocol blocks, and eFlow generates C code.
/eni: An in-development neural acquisition and processing framework. Channel count and sample rate depend on the acquisition hardware.
/eoffice: An eleven-application office suite that runs natively on EmbeddedOS devices, sharing one storage backend and UI framework.
/eos: A real-time operating system kernel for resource-constrained devices, with preemptive scheduling, a modular driver model and a POSIX-style API.
/eosuite: Applications across six categories — native C and LVGL apps, browser extensions and mobile companions — all MIT licensed with source.
/eradar360: A design-stage automotive sensing concept combining radar, laser detection, V2X and edge AI. Performance has not been validated.
/eserviceapps: Companion mobile applications for EmbeddedOS products, connecting to EoS devices over BLE, Wi-Fi or USB.
/fundraising: How donations fund open-source OS development, free certification and embedded engineering education at the Foundation.
/health: Four open health-research designs in development. Clinical validation and regulatory review are pending; displayed signals are illustrative.
/health-compare: A side-by-side comparison of four in-development health research designs. Listed capabilities are design goals, not measured results.
/industries: How the Foundation's OS, bootloader and driver layers apply across aerospace, medical, industrial and energy hardware.
/mission: The Foundation's mission and scope: advancing open-source embedded systems research, education and technology for the public benefit.
/neural-link-ai: An in-development neural-interface research platform. Channel count and sample rate depend on hardware; no clinical performance is claimed.
/privacy: How the EmbeddedOS Foundation collects, uses and protects information on this website, its documentation and its contact forms.
/product-eai: An on-device AI runtime for embedded systems, running language, vision and audio models across NPU, GPU or CPU backends.
/product-eapps: The EoS first-party application ecosystem, distributed through the eApps package manager and installable on any EoS device.
/product-eboot: A portable, fail-safe bootloader across multiple architectures, supporting A/B update slots, measured boot and a unified BSP model.
/product-ebuild: The EoS build system and SDK generator: a CLI that compiles, signs, packages and flashes firmware, and generates per-component SDKs.
/product-edb: A multi-model embedded database for EoS devices, combining SQL, document and key-value stores in one engine with at-rest encryption.
/product-eipc: A capability-secured, authenticated IPC fabric for EoS, routing messages between tasks, processes and boards with HMAC-SHA256 integrity.
/product-eni: An in-development platform for EEG, EMG, ECoG, LFP and spike-train research. Performance limits remain research targets.
/product-eoffice: An eleven-application office suite for EoS devices, sharing a unified storage backend, inter-app communication and UI framework.
/product-eos: The preemptive real-time kernel at the centre of EoS, supporting ARM, RISC-V, x86 and other architectures behind a unified HAL.
/product-eos-platform: A concept for managing EoS device fleets: over-the-air updates, telemetry, remote debugging and configuration management.
/product-eosim: A full-system virtual platform simulator for EoS firmware, with a GPIO visualizer, UART terminal, HIL bridge and GDB support.
/product-eostudio: The IDE for EoS development: a code editor with EoS-aware completion, a board picker, HAL configurator and integrated build pipeline.
/product-eserviceapps: Consumer-facing service applications for EoS devices, built offline-first with end-to-end encryption and EIPC integration.
/programmes: The Foundation's organised activities — ambassadors, university partnerships, grants and the programmes supporting members.
/quantum: The eQC module extends the EoS kernel with QPU scheduling and a hardware abstraction layer for quantum processors.
/research: Open research across embedded AI, neural interfaces, OS architecture and hardware security, published openly by the Foundation.
/sponsors: How organisations sponsor the Foundation, and what sponsorship funds across infrastructure, education and open research.
/transparency: Who the Foundation legally is, how to verify that independently, and when its financial reports become public.
/what-we-do: The open-source projects the Foundation builds — secure boot, a real-time OS, communications, applications, tooling and on-device AI.
